semantics.vectors: torsor differences retained at learned continuation boundaries
semantics.basis: uncentered SVD row span; no hidden-state origin is selected
semantics.residual: relative distance to a sampled span; diagnostic only
semantics.decision: strict held-out relative ordering; ties are not wins

layer0_directed_qk.description: both directed layer-0 QK cross tensors, concatenated

qk_transition_zip.description: six layer-indexed QK delta-tau vectors, concatenated

typed_transition_zip.description: all ordered typed-boundary delta-tau vectors, concatenated

exploration.protocol: hold out one whole template and one disjoint lexical fold

confirmation.protocol: fit all three exploration templates, then test unseen by-template and new lexemes

semantics.input: X[i]=(U_a-I)(U_b-I)k evaluated before each residual block
semantics.pulled: Y[i]=(U_a-I)(U_b-I)(k after F) for the real residual map F
semantics.recursive_dictionary: depth d uses [k,U_F k,...,U_F^(d-1)k] and tests its shift through U_F
semantics.product: attention and FFN pullbacks remain separate scale-indexed factors
semantics.representation_defect: distance of Y from the sampled function-value span of X
semantics.descent_defect: failure of kernel(X) to remain in kernel(Y)
semantics.validation_prediction: relative error of X_validation (X_fit pseudoinverse Y_fit)
semantics.training_relation_projection: optional root relation basis fitted only on each training split
semantics.scope_of_action: F is one repeated endomorphic residual block, not a token-extension action

scope: finite evidence for continuation geometry, not a recovered global grammar
residual-block closure does not establish or refute closure under grammatical token actions
no residual or norm is used as a completion score
no inference speedup follows from this diagnostic
